name: skill-audit
title_zh: 装了一堆 skill 之后，先查哪些在互相打架
tagline_zh: 装到第十个 skill 就开始互相抢触发词，改完模型更是集体过期。它逐个比对触发条件、指令冲突和实际收益。
tagline_en: Once you're ten skills deep, triggers collide and model upgrades silently rot them. It compares triggers.
desc_en: Audit installed skills for overlapping triggers, conflicting or outdated instructions, and evidence of usefulness. Use when the user requests a skill-library review, a skill audit after a model upgrade, or a comparison of an existing skill against a simpler or no-skill baseline.
why_zh: 不只看描述像不像，而是拿触发条件做重叠检测，再跟「不用 skill」的基线对照，收益说不清的就建议删。
why_en: It doesn't just eyeball descriptions: it detects trigger overlap and benchmarks against a no-skill baseline, flagging any skill.
limit_zh: 只审本机已装的 skill，不替你写新的、也不自动改文件；对照基线要真跑一遍任务，耗时取决于 skill 数量。
limit_en: Audits only locally installed skills; writes no new ones and edits nothing. Baseline runs cost real task time, and usefulness depends on the.
title_en: Audit installed skills for overlap and conflicts
